instruction: Move the yellow triangle to the right edge of the image while keeping it vertically centered.

metadata.explanation: Task requires moving the yellow triangle to the right edge while keeping it vertically centered. Evaluator checks if the triangle centroid x-position is beyond 85% from left (right edge) and y-position is within 15% of the vertical center.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both requirements: triangle at right edge (x > 85% width) and vertically centered (|y - center| < 15% height)
Logic flow is sound: loads image, detects triangle via color frequency analysis, calculates centroid, checks geometric constraints
Postconfig appropriately exports the GIMP image to PNG for verification
Thresholds are reasonable: 85% for right edge detection, 15% tolerance for vertical centering
Binary scoring (1.0/0.0) is appropriate for this geometric positioning task
Minor assumption: triangle detected as second-most-common color works for this specific simple image but could fail with complex backgrounds
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding explicit yellow color verification if the task specifically requires the triangle to remain yellow
Could add more robust triangle detection (e.g., shape-based detection) for cases with complex backgrounds, though current approach is sufficient for the given task
